verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents its own LLM-oriented sizing features. These are a markdown output mode 'optimized for LLMs and AI agents' that works across every API at 'roughly half the tokens', a fields parameter that trims payload, and an explicit RAG use case. However, nothing shows results being ranked or scored for relevance as LLM context beyond the engine's native ordering. Missing for 10: LLM-relevance ranking/scoring of results, token-budget or chunk-size controls, full-page content extraction for context, independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG suitability.
